data.description:
Dry yourself after a relaxing shower with this soft and absorbent towel that is a smart pick for everyday use.

Product Details
  • Dimensions/Size: 1m x 1.8m
  • Material: Cotton
  • Colour: Ocean
Additional Information
  • Care instructions: Machine wash according to instructions on the care label

Keep your little one cosy with this Long Sleeve Terry Towel Set. Designed for babies, it includes a long-sleeve sweatshirt and matching trackpants, making it perfect for playtime, naptime or warm days out.

Product Details
  • Baby
  • Includes 1 sweatshirt and 1 pair of trackpants
Material
  • Polyester and cotton
  • Terry towelling fabric
Features
  • Stripe detail
  • Ribbed crew neck, long raglan sleeves with ribbed cuffs and ribbed hem top
  • Elastic waistband, wide leg shape and full length trackpants
Care Instructions
  • Turn garment inside out
  • Warm machine wash with similar colours
  • Do not bleach
  • May be tumble dried warm
  • Warm iron on reverse side if required
  • Do not dry-clean

This product is not available to purchase at any bricks and mortar Kmart Stores.

Enjoy easy-going comfort every day with our Australian Cotton Classic T-Shirt. Using soft Australian cotton, this t-shirt is gentle against your skin and offers a relaxed, classic fit for a look that feels just right. The crew neckline and short sleeves make it a simple choice for casual days, layering under your favourite jumpers, or teaming with jeans. Lightweight and breathable, it's designed to help you stay cool, whether you’re relaxing at home or catching up with friends. Refresh your collection with this must-have staple and experience true comfort with every wear.

Features

  • Womens classic t-shirt

  • Made from Australian cotton
  • 160gsm
  • Single jersey fabric
  • Regular fit
  • Ribbed crew neckline
  • Short sleeves
  • Model wears a size S

     

Materials

  • 100% Australian Cotton

Care Instructions

WASH BEFORE WEAR
WARM MACHINE WASH WITH LIKE COLOURS
DO NOT BLEACH
DO NOT TUMBLE DRY
HOT IRON (DO NOT IRON PRINTS OR EMBELLISHMENTS)
DRY CLEANABLE ℗.

Extra Info

AUSTRALIAN COTTON

A natural, premium quality fibre grown by Australian farmers who care for the environment. Breathable and soft to touch. Cotton is comfortable, easy to wear and easy to care for.


Material:
  • Australian Cotton
